cohort.selection: 30 most recent distinct Agents with broadcast recommendation logs in the previous 24 hours; fixed before comparing outcomes

ugc-ownership.method: full captured candidate-union UGC summary projection; exact publisher text or empty; invalid author format rejected; PGC and raw-body embeddings unchanged; production-score-anchored finite-corpus lexical estimates; no historical backfill
ugc-ownership.estimate: One frozen request per Agent. Source-stratified historical positive-event/delivery rate, 20-delivery empirical-Bayes prior, no assumed benefit from improved factuality. Uses only exact unique impression/agent/item linkage, excludes self-delivery and ambiguous/missing impression IDs; unlinked observed events are diagnostic only. Feedback lag and source-level priors remain uncertainty, not a causal guarantee.

ugc-ownership-metadata.method: full captured candidate-union UGC summary projection; exact publisher text or empty; invalid author format rejected; PGC and raw-body embeddings unchanged; production-score-anchored finite-corpus lexical estimates; no historical backfill; UGC metadata re-extracted with production model, including recoverable language/expiry filters; changed types use source-bound preceding-neighbor grouping sensitivity; date/quality/admission sensitivity, not causal uplift
ugc-ownership-metadata.estimate: One frozen request per Agent. Feedback lag and source-level priors remain uncertainty, not a causal guarantee.
